theme.description: Theme is the tempo color theme, passed to the CLI via --theme.

configDir.description: ConfigDir specifies the $XDG_CONFIG_HOME where configuration files are stored.

profiles.description: Profiles maps a name to a Temporal connection profile; names autocomplete in the shell.

Config.description: Config is the tempo provider configuration: the color theme, an optional XDG config directory, and the named Temporal connection profiles.

cluster.description:
Cluster to use for the kubectl command, optional; defaults to the
consumer's profile or env name

resource.description: Resource pod or service, e.g. svc/grafana

namespace.description: Namespace of the target pod or service

profile.description: Profile to use for the kubectl command, optional

PortForwardTarget.description: PortForwardTarget identifies the pod or service a kubectl port-forward is opened against to reach a server only reachable from inside the cluster.

url.description: URL is the Temporal server address (host:port), passed to the CLI via --address.

urlForward.description:
URLForward replaces URL with the local address of a kubectl port-forward
to the given target. Its cluster, or the profile name if unset, is used as
the kubectl cluster name.

description.description: Description is shown in shell autocompletion.

kubeforward.description: Kubeforward is the port forwarding configuration for the Temporal server.

Profile.description: Profile identifies a Temporal server by address, with a description shown in shell autocompletion.
